findings.evidence: `FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat` provides this interface at `FiniteType/CommHopfAlgCat.lean:73-145`, while `rg "GeometricallyConnectedCommHopfAlgCat"` finds no corresponding namespace or declarations beyond this abbreviation and uses of its forgetful functor.
findings.fix: Add the standard bundled-category API: `CoeSort`, inherited `CommRing` and `HopfAlgebra` instances, an `of` constructor, morphism conversions/constructors, extensionality, and their normal-form simp lemmas.
findings.issue: `GeometricallyConnectedCommHopfAlgCat` exposes only the full-subcategory abbreviation, so consumers cannot directly coerce its objects to types or use their ring/Hopf-algebra structures and morphisms; this makes the transported whole objects awkward downstream.

summary: The new Hopf-algebra subcategory lacks the interface needed to use its objects as bundled Hopf algebras.
